_note: Indicative demo rates. Everything is quoted against 'base', and a cross rate is rates[to]/rates[from]. 'feeBps' is basis points taken off the amount before conversion (50 bps = 0.50%); it is not charged when both sides are the same currency. 'asOf' is shown in the UI next to the word 'indicative' — never present a static table as a live rate.
